name: Shirou Aizawa
source:
Born 7/25/2033
He lost his family at a young age in an attack by the ESSAR aliens and was raised in an orphanage in India.
In order to give back to Professor Kalidasa who raised him he aims to become a highly paid 'Vector Rider'.

The protagonist of Shirou Hen and a capturable character in Sayuri Hen.
